newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems wins China contract.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems wins China contract.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc Monday said it had been chosen by China Internet Corp to provide equipment and technology for its Internet/intranet network for China.

In a statement, Sun Microsystems said China Internet intends to purchase $15 million of Sun computers, equipment and interactive network computing technology pursuant to a non-binding memorandum of understanding.
China Internet was created to utilize the latest Internet technology to build a highly reliable and secure national intranet -- the China Wide Web (CWW).

The proposed purchase is intended to cover a full range of Sun servers, network security and management products, as well as the Java computing technology. In addition to Sun's direct network system development role, the Sun products are proposed to be deployed in areas such as system administration, accounting and human resources.
